response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg FROM telescope_averages), above_average AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_above_avg FROM above_average) SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_modindex, a.avg_modindex - a.overall_avg AS amount_above_overall, a.avg_modindex / m.mean_above_avg AS ratio FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS m ORDER BY ratio DESC, a.telescref ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Ties in the ratio are broken by telescope reference in ascending order.
